name: discipline-gates
description: Pre-action discipline gates backed by real oracles. test-discipline: before fixing a bug, commit a test that fails for the stated reason; before refactoring untested code, pin its behavior as green tests; after any new test goes green, mutate-check that it can actually fail (restore-always). git-archaeologist: before deleting defensive code, recover its intent from git history and surface a Chesterton's-fence warning.
